fields.title: Refresh E-ink on view changes instead of elapsed time
fields.description: Flashing is the existing E-ink ghosting overlay, confirmed absent when E-ink is off. No periodic timer defect was established. Owner wants view-change-driven refreshes.
fields.notes: Owner smoke intake 2026-10-26. Proposed priority P2. Sources F6, R8. Acceptance/evidence: docs/planning/roadmap-reviews/2026-10-26-smoke-triage.md. Stub; investigation/specification required. Release hold unchanged.
fields.deliverable: Page/screen advances, menu changes and book entry/exit trigger the declared refresh policy; idle time and per-word updates do not. Preserve finite flash cleanup/duration and avoid duplicate flashes for one transition.
